oauth.title: Account login
oauth.description: Log in to your tracker accounts so komf can access them on your behalf.
oauth.loadFailed: Could not load account login status.
oauth.upgradeHint: Account login requires a newer komf version — upgrade komf to use it.

saveBar.invalidHint: Fix the invalid fields above to save.

validation.positiveInt: Must be a positive whole number.
validation.publisherTagPair: Publisher tag names need both a tag name and a language.
validation.charMappingPair: Character mappings need both a source and a replacement.

processing.failedMatchCollectionHelper: Series that fail auto-identify are added to this collection.
processing.bcp47Helper: BCP-47 language codes, one per line.
processing.scoreTagNameHelper: Write the score into this tag; empty disables.
processing.publisherTagNamesHelper: Tag name to use per publisher language.
processing.alternateTitleLabelsHelper: Custom labels for alternative titles; empty uses the defaults.
processing.skipWithLinksHelper: Identification skips series that already have provider links.
processing.matchByLinksHelper: Identification matches directly from existing provider links.

extraction.enabledHelper: Clean up series titles before searching providers.
extraction.bracketRegexHelper: Removed from the title before searching.
extraction.titleSplittersHelper: The title is split on these and the first part is used.
extraction.symbolNormalizeRegexHelper: Matching symbols are removed before comparing titles.
extraction.charMappingsHelper: Single characters replaced before comparing titles.
extraction.cleanupRegexesHelper: Applied in order; matches are removed from the title.

chinese.enabledHelper: Convert between Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

mylar.downloadCoversHelper: Also download series covers when exporting series.json.
mylar.outputDirHelper: Empty exports next to the series.

listener.librariesHelper: Only listen to selected libraries. Select none to listen to all.
listener.excludedSeriesHelper: Series IDs to skip during automatic metadata updates, one per line.

notifications.discordHelper: komf masks existing webhooks, so they cannot be edited here — remove and re-add to change one.
notifications.appriseUrlsHelper: Apprise notification URLs, e.g. tgram://, ntfy://. Masked entries are read-only.
notifications.notifyLibrariesHelper: Only send notifications for selected libraries. Select none to notify for all.

overrides.overrideProcessingHelper: Off inherits the global metadata update settings.
overrides.overrideProvidersHelper: Off inherits the global provider settings.
overrides.dialogFooter: Changes join the page's unsaved changes — save from the bar at the bottom.

credentials.comicVineSearchLimitHelper: Maximum number of ComicVine search results. Empty clears the configured value.

extras.titleLanguagePriorityHelper: Priority list for titles and staff names, one per line (e.g. native, romaji, english). Empty uses the account default.
extras.mangaDexLinksHelper: External links carried over from MangaDex.
extras.modeHelper: DATABASE matches against the offline MangaBaka dump.
extras.updateIntervalHelper: Hours between local database refreshes; 0 means manual only.
extras.tagWhitelistHelper: Only these tags are imported, one per line.
extras.tagWhitelistFileHelper: File with one tag per line; overrides the list above.
extras.translatorKeywordsHelper: Group names recognized as translators, one per line.
extras.tagTranslationUrlHelper: Empty uses the official EhTagTranslation release.
extras.gidOnlyMatchHelper: Auto-match only by gallery ID; link matching is unaffected.

archive.title: Offline archive
archive.enabledHelper: Match against a local archive database instead of the API.
archive.staffChineseNamesHelper: Prefer the archived Chinese names for authors and publishers.
archive.downloadUrlHelper: Empty uses the default e-hentai-db release.
archive.categoryFilterHelper: Only archive entries in these categories, one per line.
archive.uploaderFilterHelper: Only archive entries from these uploaders, one per line.

integrations.subtitle: External services connected to this server
integrations.baseUrlHelper: Address komf uses to call back into kmrs.
integrations.authKeyHelper: komf-rs access key (KOMF_AUTH_KEY); overrides the kmrs config preset. Leave blank for no override.
integrations.authKeyHelperSet: A key is stored. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new one to replace it.
integrations.disconnectBody: Disconnect komf? The stored connection and its API key are removed, and komf stops receiving metadata requests.
